description: This Java class 'ContentKeywordIndex' handles indexing of content for keyword-based search within the OFBiz framework. It gathers metadata and related entity information, processes keywords with optional stemming and stopwords, and stores keyword relevancy data for search optimization.

classes.name: ContentKeywordIndex
classes.description: Provides functionality for indexing content data for keyword search, including metadata collection, keyword processing, and storage.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Triggers reindexing of keywords for a given content entity, forcing reindex even if previously indexed.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for the specified content entity, with optional full reindexing.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method to process and index keywords for content, collecting metadata and related entity attributes, processing keywords, and storing them.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Adds text content from a DataResource to the strings list, with specified weighting for keyword importance.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string value from a specified field in a GenericValue to the strings list, with a fixed weight.
